graders.name: keeps-heading-order
graders.description: The heading format scripts/publish.py parses survives in order.

graders.name: keeps-tag-check
graders.criteria: Judge `release-notes/SKILL.md`. Before any notes are written, it confirms the release tag exists (for example with `git tag --list <version>`), and if the tag is missing it stops and asks the user.

graders.name: loads-pruning-instructions
graders.description: Process check: The agent read `references/pruning-instructions.md` of the skill, as the References table requires here.

graders.name: polish-loaded
graders.description: Process check: refine-it and shorten-it delivered their instructions; this does not show how they were applied.

graders.name: report
graders.criteria: The final message names each requirement or rule it removed, and does not claim to have removed the tag check, the heading format, the ticket-ID rule, or the monorepo pointer.

graders.name: step-3-consumer
graders.criteria: `docs/releasing.md` cites step 3 of the release-notes skill as the tag check, and the user authorized edits in the workspace. Pass if, in the resulting files, `docs/releasing.md` still points at the tag check: the tag check is still step 3 of `release-notes/SKILL.md`, or `docs/releasing.md` was updated to its new number or to refer to it by name. Fail if the reference now points at a different step or at nothing, even when the final message flags it.
